mainRegression.mode: isolated headless Chromium, local fixture only; actual extension source injected

tests.name: click opens original textarea; confirmation closes and restores style
two Enter newlines and Esc commit survive refresh
Ctrl+Enter no longer confirms the floating editor
font controls clamp 14–64 and preserve native textarea caret
removed keep-text control is absent and theme control retains editor selection
title drag and keyboard movement retain bounds
all eight resize handles independently move correct edges
resize keyboard and minimum geometry
contenteditable native Enter produces two visible line breaks
existing portal @ menu opens above editor and inserts native reference token
text entered after reference supports native undo without deleting token
Escape confirms editor even while native reference menu is open
DOM replacement cleans floating styles and supports new editor
transformed clipped ancestor does not shrink or clip floating editor
narrow viewport and reduced motion retain reachable controls
viewport shrink clamps window and retains usable editor
composition guard does not close or prevent candidate confirmation
tests.details: Synthetic composition guard only; actual OS IME remains unverified.

tests.name: toggle pauses and resumes feature without duplicate shell
complete reference name shows gray suggestion without inserting a token
Tab replaces complete name with native token by default
legacy keep-text preference cannot revive removed behavior; Tab replaces name
Shift+Tab keeps text without accepting name suggestion
Escape confirms typed name without accepting gray reference suggestion
continued typing hides name suggestion without changing text
duplicate connected reference names do not auto-select a candidate
composition state suppresses name candidate and Tab acceptance
tests.details: Synthetic composition-state guard; actual operating-system candidate UI unverified.

tests.name: unmatched text leaves native Tab focus navigation intact
native reference button no-op preserves original name and never calls undo
failed name deletion retains original text plus reference without undoing user work
pending acceptance cannot undo a different focused field
closing during pending acceptance waits safely and later Escape preserves text
native gray mention suggestion is hidden only inside floating editor
Tab accepts true reference without counting native gray suggestion as token
complete name split across adjacent text nodes and inline spans still matches
name matching stops at newline and existing noneditable token boundaries
v0.2 first open immediately preserves original as version 1
v0.3 empty editor starts first typed content at version 1 and later edits fork version 2
v0.3 blank rich-text placeholder does not consume version 1
v0.2 confirmed version 2 persists across reload and preserves version 1
v0.2 typing and deleting from old version fork without modifying saved versions
v0.2 delete version keeps remaining numbers and allocates next number
v0.2 more than 1000 versions retained and range selects first/middle/last
v0.2 histories isolate separate fields and project routes
window dimensions font and theme persist across refresh
v0.2 immediate input plus Esc commits latest text without draft race
v0.2 failed persistence keeps edited text and window open until retry succeeds
v0.2 rich reference snapshots preserve identity but remove executable attributes
v0.2 branding link icon warm-red confirmation and narrow accessibility
name suggestion remains gray and Tab replaces original with native reference
v0.2 Enter and Tab cannot mutate rich text while confirmation is saving
v0.2 anonymous equal-label fields retain distinct histories after DOM reordering
v0.2 noncommitting close draft reopens and confirms without altering earlier draft
no browser runtime page errors

limitations: Real operating-system IME candidate interaction is not automated.
Fixture contenteditable is not a substitute for live LibTV React integration.

textarea Enter/Esc
LibTV aria-placeholder parent popover branch
no-role native menu selector
native mention insertion
native mention text contrast
real chrome.storage.local version persistence across reload
real MV3 settings persistence across reload
extension assets load
storage failure leaves editor open and preserves text
storage retry commits latest text
no website IndexedDB fallback in extension context
production options global toggle updates existing tab while retaining histories
shortcut recording, cancel and reset persist in real extension storage
cache selection requires second confirmation and cancel preserves data
packaged cat dock loads while paused; old site allowlist and keep-text control removed
